fragments.text: May the utterance of our lips be pleasing before Thee, O lofty and exalted God, who understands and listens, pays heed and hearkens to the sound of
our Teruah. Mayest Thou accept with compassion and favour the order of our praises of Thy Kingdom.

title.en: May the utterance of our lips be pleasing
